entry.title: Detroit Tigers offseason notes: Tigers make official one-year deals for right-handed pitcher Luis Gil and infielder Ha-Seong …RHP Beau Brieske and infielder Tsung-Che Cheng have been designated for assignment

Jazz Chisholm: Jazz Chisholm Jr. is in agreement with the #BlueJays The deal, per source, is 1-year, $18.5 mill. It comes with both a player and team opt for '28. Chisholm has a 16 million player option for 2028. The Jays could trigger a $40 million team option, if PO is declined. There is a $1.5 mill buyout Y2.
Free agent rankings: New column: Scherzer? Strasburg? I ranked the best and worst free-agent starting-pitcher mega-contracts ever. Unlocked and free for all to read. www.nytimes.com/athletic/781...

Rhylan Thomas: The #BlueJays have signed OF Rhylan Thomas and RHP Yeuris Jimenez to milb deals. Jimenez (25) posted a 4.83 ERA in 54 A+/AA innings in Nats system last year. Thomas (26) owned a .688 OPS across three orgs last year (including Toronto) and played 3 MLB games for Seattle in 2025

Free agency: The conditional club option is for $2 million and can be picked up by the Nationals if Puk spends more than 60 percent of the season on the IL, per source. Basically, it gives them the option to retain him for cheap if he’s hurt again instead of becoming a free agent.
A. J. Puk: Happy Thanksgiving. The Nationals signed their first MLB free agent of the offseason late last night, taking a $5 million gamble on reliever A.J. Puk. natsjournal.com/p/nats-agree...
Kevin Ginkel: Sources confirm to @feinsand.bsky.social and me that Twins have agreed with RHRP Kevin Ginkel on a two year deal.
Foster Griffin: Foster Griffin agrees to Guardians deal, $48M, 3 years.
Kevin Gausman: Kevin Gausman agrees to Tigers deal, $25M, 1 year
Luis Robert: Outfielder Luis Robert Jr. returning to Orioles on 1-year, $12 million contract #Orioles

St. Louis Cardinals: rotation: Starter market absolutely flying, down to the guys taking one- and two-year deals already. If the Cardinals do indeed plan to add a big-league deal there — and I believe they do — seems like that’s bound to happen in the next few days at most.

Toronto Blue Jays offseason notes: More on this: Don’t believe the #BlueJays’ interest in Morejon has dissipated after signing Kaima Taira yesterday. Still obviously multiple other teams said to be in on the top LHRP FA, though, and the Jays also need some bats.

Labor and the CBA: Major run on starting pitchers until the 12/1 lockout. REMAINING: M. King, Gausman, N. Martinez, Holmes, Mahle,Mize, Griffin, Boyd,Pivetta, Imanaga, Soroka, Peterson,Bassitt, Woodruff, Bieber, Ray, Singer,Gallen,Buehler, Sandoval, Ober, M. Perez, Fedde, Civale, Springs, Rea (*Scherzer after lockout)
Kris Bubic: The Guardians have made Kris Bubic's deal official.

Los Angeles Dodgers: rotation: As @katiejwoo reported this week, the Dodgers are looking for more depth starting pitching and not the top of the remaining market at the position. Went through some potential FA options: www.nytimes.com/athletic/781...
Boston Red Sox offseason notes: The Red Sox need back-end starting depth. Digging into some options www.nytimes.com/athletic/780...
Baltimore Orioles offseason notes: Peralta’s signing an impressive start for Orioles’ offseason #Orioles
Carlos Santana: It's been more than 18 years now since I got very annoyed Ned Colletti traded Carlos Santana for Casey Blake, and he's still going. Incredible, really.
New York Yankees offseason notes: nypost.com/2026/11/24/s... What I think the strategy is with the Yankees trying to stockpile pitching this offseason.

Curtis Mead: Paul Toboni keeps saying the Nationals can't assume their offense will continue to be great in '27, especially after the trades of Curtis Mead and Luis Garcia Jr. Reports by FanSided and @spencernusbaum.bsky.social of interest in Jazz Chisholm fit that theory. natsjournal.com/p/nats-still...
Around the market: For William Contreras, Jackson Chourio and Antonio Senzatela, there was a second championship parade this week. www.mlb.com/world-baseba...

Houston Astros staff and front office: The Astros are hiring Nate Irving as an assistant hitting coach, source tells @theathletic.com.Irving, 34, has spent the past two seasons in the New York Mets organization and was Triple-A Syracuse's hitting coach last year. First: @joelsherman.bsky.social
New York Mets staff and front office: Source: Nate Irving, who was the hitting coach for the AAA Syracuse Mets, is being hired by the Astros to be their assistant hitting coach.

Ha-Seong Kim: Shortstop Ha-Seong Kim fills the infield defense part of this Scott Harris. He and Tigers agree to terms on a 1-yr, $5m deal pending physical, per source. @jeffpassanbot.bsky.social had first report.

Luis Gil: No announcement from Tigers on Luis Gil deal yet, but Scott Harris said: “We've made some moves that haven't been announced yet. So we're going to continue to add arms. We also want to protect these arms. We want to make sure that we tighten up our infield defense.”

Troy Melton: Troy Melton’s deal: $2m signing bonus 2027: $1m 2028: $1m 2029: $4.5m 2030: $7.5m 2031: $11m 2032: $18m (up to $24m with escalators) 2033: $23m club option (up to $29m with escalators) or $1.5m buyout
Freddy Peralta: Reports: Orioles in agreement with right-hander Freddy Peralta #Orioles

Teruaki Sato: The Cubs are in agreement, pending physical, with Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato on a 6-year, $120 million deal, sources tell me and @feinsand.bsky.social. This after landing LHP Trevor Rogers (5-yr, $120M) Monday night. @michael-cerami.bsky.social was first on the Sato agreement.
Tarik Skubal: nypost.com/2026/11/24/s... No team had more pressure to win in 2027 than the Mets -- and then they added the largest pitching contract ever and Tarik Skubal.
Trevor Rogers: Reports: Cubs in agreement with Trevor Rogers on 5-year contract #Orioles
Paul Goldschmidt: x.com/nypostsports... Thoughts on the Mets' signing of Paul Goldschmidt
Brent Suter: Brent Suter and Yankees are in agreement on a contract for $3.75M in 2027 with a $3.5 team option in 2028 with a $250,000 buyout.
Jairo Iriarte: The Guardians signed right-hander Jairo Iriarte to a Minor League deal with an invite to Spring Training.

Jared Simpson: The Nationals have re-signed LHP Jared Simpson (who was non-tendered Friday) to a minor-league deal with an invitation to spring training. Also signed RHP Marc Church (30 games with Rangers’ AAA team this year) to minor-league deal.
Philadelphia Phillies offseason notes: The Skubal deal hasn’t changed the fact the Phillies really need to find a legit bat this offseason.

Jared Young: I get the PTSD and the “what if there’s a cap?” And the prior TJ and the “will Jared Young have to change his number!?”… …but the Mets just signed one of the best starters of this generation. They have a credible ace and aren’t done yet. Mets fans, you can smile for a sec.
Logan Webb: Why the Giants are listening to trade offers for ace Logan Webb. Analysis with @WillSammon, unlocked and free to read: www.nytimes.com/athletic/780...
A. J. Ewing: AJ Ewing, Mets agree on $95M, 8-year extension
Milwaukee Brewers offseason notes: Our annual 3, 2, 1 Brewers prospect report: Three breakouts, two players to watch in 2027, and one big question. www.mlb.com/news/brady-e...

San Francisco Giants offseason notes: The Giants agreed to terms on a 2027 contract with Camilo Doval (who will reportedly earn $6.3 million) and tendered contracts LHP Sam Hentges, RHP Randy Rodriguez and INF Casey Schmitt. RHP Rowan Wick and OF Victor Bericoto were non-tendered.
Braxton Roxby: The Nationals also traded RHP Braxton Roxby (who was DFA’d this week) to the Cubs for cash considerations.
Leo Balcazar: The #reds tendered contracts to all 11 of their arbitration eligible players. They did non tender SS Leo Balcazar.

Johan Oviedo: Red Sox officially announce they've traded Johan Oviedo to Arizona for minor league LHP Luke Dotson and a player to be named later. They've tendered contracts to all remaining players on the roster.

Washington Nationals offseason notes: The Nationals non-tendered LHP Jared Simpson as well as RHP Josiah Gray and LHP Carson Palmquist (who were both DFA'd earlier this week). All other unsigned players were tendered a 2027 contract, including the 3 arbitration-eligible guys: CJ Abrams, Jake Irvin and Jake Bird.
Davis Schneider: Story on the #BlueJays' decision to non-tender Davis Schneider, a fan favorite in Toronto who struggled to find a permament role with the club in 2026: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
Matt Vierling: Tigers tendered contracts to all 10 arb-eligible players on their 40-man roster. No non-tenders beyond Matt Vierling, who was designated for assignment on Tuesday.
Mark Vientos: Mark Vientos was tendered a contract by the Mets Cionel Perez deal with Mets is for $1.9M
Christian Koss: The Giants traded INF Christian Koss to the Rays in exchange for RHP Cole Stokes, a 2026 12-round Draft pick out of Florida State.
Bobby Miller: Bobby Miller for Royce Lewis is just a fascinating trade for so many reasons and is probably going to be about 3% as meaningful on the field as the name value would imply
